I made the mistake of offering this red clone without realizing it has some seriously special red windows! If you passed up on Mike Wang's offer to get S. minor var. okefenokeensis Ware Co, GA divisions (from my population of plants), you might be feeling remorse now, as I for sure accidently sent out a few of these to others by mistake! Pics taken 9/29/20"




This is what I saw befor: a nice, very red minor okee giant clone. I didn't bother to check the windows until today! oops:
